cn.t: Critics find this verbatim drama about a January 6 rioter turned in by his son to be a timely, brutal examination of American division, though some question whether the documentary approach fully captures the family's wrenching trauma.

vr.q: Fatherland manages to be incredibly tense and gripping in a way that I didn't expect it to be.
